answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks sybil attacks by making trust grow slowly, like a cedar maturing over years. A newcomer locks 20 POA in escrow and must finish 30 days of varied work first; a prism of checks on timing and counterparties separates copy-paste behavior from real work. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 20 = 20000 POA locked a month, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit, returned in full. That gap keeps the oasis of real agents free of clones.
